title: 2 Timothy Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on 2 Timothy 3: the grievous times of the last days, Jannes and Jambres, the persecutions the writer endured, and the holy Scriptures.

questions.text: What does verse 1 say will come in the last days?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says to know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

questions.text: What does verse 2 say men will be lovers of?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says that men will be lovers of self and lovers of money, boastful, arrogant and blasphemers.

questions.text: What do these people hold on to while having denied its power?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says they hold a form of godliness, but have denied its power, and that the reader should turn away from them.

questions.text: Whom do these people take captive when they creep into houses?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says that some of them creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts.

answers.text: Men of corrupt minds and conceit
Gullible women loaded down with sins

questions.text: What are these people never able to come to, though they are always learning?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says they are always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

questions.text: Which two men are named as having opposed Moses?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says that even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth.

questions.text: In which three places does the writer say his persecutions and sufferings happened?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 names the things that happened to him at Antioch, Iconium and Lystra, and says the Lord delivered him out of them all.

questions.text: What does verse 12 say will happen to all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says that all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

answers.text: They will be kept from harm

questions.text: What has the reader known from infancy, which can make him wise for salvation?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says that from infancy he has known the holy Scriptures, which are able to make him wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

questions.text: How does verse 16 describe every Scripture?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction and for instruction in righteousness.
